E7 When a person is under the influence of drink and/or drugs, it is not intended that they are to
be treated as vulnerable and requiring an appropriate adult for the purpose of Annex E
paragraph 1 unless other information indicates that any of the factors described in
paragraph 1.13(d) may apply to that person. W hen the person has recovered from the
effects of drink and/or drugs, they should be re- assessed in accordance with Annex E
paragraph 1. See paragraph 15.4A for application to live link.
